Therefore, I have made this simple app, that let's you build a small or medium widget for your home screen.

TikWidgets is unique and deeply customisable. It comes with a free option or with subscriptions.

You can:
- apply a background image
- change the background colour 
- alter its transparency 
- change the labels colour

If you're serious about growing on TikTok, TikWidgets also offers:
- Hashtag lists per category and theme
- Trending musics to discover
- Trending accounts to follow
- Trending challenges to reproduce

Cherry on the cake: you can track multiple accounts.

*Works only on public profiles

TikWidgets is not and will never collect any data. This is YOUR tool. It's important for us that your account stays untouched and that's why using TikWidgets will not get you shadow banned.

Visit https://www.appwithflow.com/streamer-widgets-eula to read and understand how the service works, the Terms of Use & the Privacy Policy.

Compatible with any iOS device!
